**Major update: Adds richer data sourcing options, emphasizes measured/estimated data, and clarifies workflow.**

- Adds detailed guidance for keyless/local data sources (Autocomplete, Firecrawl SERP sampling, Wikipedia pageviews, GSC striking distance).
- Clarifies that metrics must be labeled as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated—never invent or mislabel data.
- Introduces "Impact × Confidence" priority scoring as an optional advanced layer atop standard opportunity scoring.
- Updates skill metadata, compatibility, file paths, and removes deprecated/duplicated references.

- Improves references and example links; streamlines instructions and output requirements.

Version 3.0.0 of keyword-research introduces major enhancements for keyword analysis and integration:

- Added support and documentation for advanced integrations (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Keyword Planner, Google Search Console, or manual input).
- Expanded description and triggers to cover new use cases such as keyword difficulty score, search volume data, CPC estimates, long-tail keyword suggestions, and content calendar planning.
- Includes compatibility info for multiple marketplaces and environments (Claude Code, skills.sh, ClawHub, Vercel Labs).
- Added new reference files: example keyword report and prioritization framework.
- Improved metadata and tags to reflect modern SEO workflows (topic clusters, pillar pages, CPC, search intent classification).
- Retains all core research, classification, and opportunity scoring features from earlier versions.

**Major update: Added detailed triggers, metadata, and library integration for improved discoverability and guidance.**

- Expanded the description with explicit usage triggers and when-to-use guidance.
- Added YAML frontmatter with author, version, license, geo-relevance, and tags.
- Listed skill triggers and linked related skills for research, build, optimize, monitor, and cross-cutting SEO tasks.
- Clarified when to use competitor-analysis and content-gap-analysis for specialized cases.
- Included SEO & GEO Skills Library reference and install instructions for broader utility.
- All original functional instructions (how to research, score, and cluster keywords) remain intact.

- No code or documentation changes detected in this version.

Initial release of the keyword-research skill:

- Enables comprehensive keyword discovery, intent classification, and difficulty assessment.
- Prioritizes keywords using an opportunity scoring system.
- Identifies high-potential GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AI-answer-friendly keywords.
- Supports topic cluster creation for strategic content planning.
- Works with manual input or connected SEO tools for flexible data sourcing.
- Provides clear, actionable instructions and output templates for streamlined keyword research reporting.
